Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-transcribe-medium-0052", "row_sha256": "8dd65c974749aba3bcdd97e682d0df3d4e1bb2e086a427ed25e63791519b0feb", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "for the west creek neighborhood survey export i need a copy for the library meeting on thursday um please include responses received through may 12 not the newer test entries from may 13 the response count is 164 no 146 sorry 146 households first put the question summary on the overview tab second make a separate tab for open comments with the street names left out third add a column showing whether each respondent agreed to a follow-up call if that answer is blank leave it blank don't guess from the comment the next tab is called checks right that's the one with the duplicate review actually call it review not checks because the volunteers use that label keep the original question wording in the export including the question about bus service and don't combine the two school questions yeah that matters people answered those differently please sort the overview by ward number and then by submission date oldest first the ward field should stay numeric and include the export date in a note at the top i think the file should be a spreadsheet and send it to Mara before noon Wednesday if the date filter can't exclude the test entries cleanly tell me what remains in the export before you share it", "output": "For the West Creek neighborhood survey export, I need a copy for the library meeting on Thursday. Please include responses received through May 12, not the newer test entries from May 13. The response count is 146 households. First, put the question summary on the overview tab. Second, make a separate tab for open comments, with the street names left out. Third, add a column showing whether each respondent agreed to a follow-up call. If that answer is blank, leave it blank; don't guess from the comment. The next tab is called checks, right? That's the one with the duplicate review. Actually, call it review, not checks, because the volunteers use that label. Keep the original question wording in the export, including the question about bus service, and don't combine the two school questions. Yeah, that matters; people answered those differently. Please sort the overview by ward number and then by submission date, oldest first. The ward field should stay numeric, and include the export date in a note at the top. I think the file should be a spreadsheet, and send it to Mara before noon Wednesday. If the date filter can't exclude the test entries cleanly, tell me what remains in the export before you share it."}]
